catalog_version.description: Content catalog version pointer (delivery design §7). Percentage conditions on this param provide canary rollout and rollback.

highlight_artist.description: Showcase: featured artist (ArtistId). Must exist in the active catalog.

highlight_collection_of_the_week.description: Showcase: collection of the week (CategoryId). Must name a Collection-type category; a Singles category is ignored and the highlight is omitted. stillscenes~featured exists from catalog 20260709-04 onward.

highlight_just_added.description: Showcase: just-added row (CategoryId). Currently unread by the client: the Just Added row resolves FolderDefinitions.FolderIdJustAdded directly.

highlight_most_popular.description: Showcase: most-popular row (CategoryId). Must exist in the active catalog.

highlight_wallpaper_of_the_week.description: Showcase: wallpaper of the week (RemixId). Alpine Dawn. Must exist in the active catalog.
